items.title: Snapchat now lets developers build AR Lenses with AI assistants like Claude Code and Cursor
items.summary: Lens creators can describe the Lens they want in plain language, and their AI assistant handles the process from start to finish, Snapchat says.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: Spend management platform Payhawk announces $280M raise, 2B valuation
items.summary: Founded in 2018, Payhawk is an enterprise financial management platform that helps companies track and manage expenses and procurement using AI agents.
items.creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
